title: Displacement of a Mouse Pointer
body: A mouse pointer on a computer monitor is initially at point $$(6.0\, \text{cm$$,} $$1.6\, \text{cm})$$ with respect to the lower-left corner. You move the pointer to an icon at point $$(2.0\, \text{cm$$,} $$4.5\, \text{cm})$$. $$Let$$ $$\vec{B}$$ with components $$(6.0\, \text{cm$$,} $$1.6\, \text{cm})$$ be the position vector of the starting point relative to the lower-left corner of the monitor and let $$\vec{E}$$ with components $$(2.0\, \text{cm$$,} $$4.5\, \text{cm})$$ be the position vector of the ending point relative to the lower-left corner of the monitor. What is the displacement vector of the pointer?
